basic_profile.bio: I'm a North Carolina State alum who majored in Religious Studies. I have a deep appreciation for woodworking, which I picked up during a summer workshop. I'm a fan of strategy games and spend my free time designing custom emblems for For Honor. Currently based in Raleigh, I work as a freelance graphic designer. I’m usually online during the evenings, especially around the weekends when I have more time to engage with my favorite communities. I'm in a long-term relationship with my college sweetheart, and we both enjoy cozy nights with Animal Crossing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My academic background in Religious Studies from NCSU provided me with critical thinking skills and a solid understanding of cultural contexts, which I've applied to my hobbies and professional work. I continually learn about woodworking through online resources and community forums. My interest in gaming and design is largely self-taught, fueled by online tutorials and community interactions.
